rows.method: The exact 1600x900 JPEG and a 360-pixel Lanczos preview were opened. This is an actual current material inspection, not an additional blind review.
rows.observation: At 360 px the legend explicitly names Geschwindigkeit and Pfeilmaßstab. Both arrows start at the point on the same cart and point right. The upper complete arrow is twice the 2 m/s reference bar; the lower is one 4 m/s bar within line width, so both show 4 m/s. The carts remain at the same schematic position and both tips end freely. No vector addition is drawn. Quantity, direction, own scale and the non-place meaning of the changed tip are now explicit.
